scope: Disposable tenants through authenticated HTTP, real PostgreSQL, Restate and native receipts. Controlled HTTP model, object storage and report receiver only.

arrival.completionBound: steadyMs+burstMs+interactiveP95Ms; await final admission responses, and fail if actual arrivals exceed this fixed bound

interpretation: Report admitted, nonterminal, waiting roots, active model operations and child tasks independently. Passing root admission does not establish active concurrency. Preserve failed targets and resource limits without reducing a target. Website control roots are reported separately from the configured root target.

statusProbes.selection: Round robin configured tenants independently of traffic volume

faultRecovery: Track injection/restoration timestamps and affected native roots or Collector export intents. Reconciliation includes truthful terminal uncertainty after worker loss; it never changes uncertainty into confirmed success. Provider throttling is removed after configured arrivals and retains native rejected receipts.

physicalAttribution.successfulCalls: Exact native providerRequestId plus canonical serialized request digest
physicalAttribution.faultCalls: Unique native context digest/step/attempt lookup before local HTTP dispatch; ambiguous matches fail
physicalAttribution.scopeMarkers: Immutable fixture agent ID in published instructions and parent request digest in delegated brief
physicalAttribution.effects: Exact native action/task/root/artifact IDs, canonical payload and byte digests, receiver receipt and POST audit
physicalAttribution.collector: Retained bounded parsed actual span/trace/observation/task/root IDs and metric names; correlate sampled affected native export intents after restoration

faultTiming.scope: Fault-only timing; no-fault arrival mix and thresholds unchanged

queueMetrics.root: Root task_outbox dispatched_at-created_at, parent_task_id IS NULL
queueMetrics.child: All children with any native operation, including later cancelled children, plus every noncancelled child: first operations.started_at minus tasks.created_at, separately graded against queueAgeP95Ms. Only cancelled children with no native operation are exempt. This is activation, not invocation-binding time.
queueMetrics.legacy: All-outbox latency retained ungraded; child outboxes are terminal-cleanup records rather than dispatcher routing

telemetryEvidence.scope: After load timing stops, observe actual periodic Collector trace/metric output. No synthetic observations, export-interval changes, or workload/fault SLO allowance.
